text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We came to the hot springs to take a 
breather. ...This will surely be an 
important rest. I need to think carefully 
so she can relax to the fullest—"
choice_data_list:
(The benefits of each hot spring and info 
on the surrounding area, all in my 
notebook…)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, is something the matter?
choice_data_list: （各温泉の効能、周辺の情報は手帳に……）
choice_data_list_en: (The hot spring benefits and local info are all in my notebook...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: なんでもないよ！そう、やりたいことある？
choice_data_list_en: It's nothing! So, is there anything you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, I have spotted amazake over there. 
It should provide adequate nourishment—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(Confirmed Master's eyebrows have drawn 
together 2 millimeters closer than normal. 
She appears to be checking her 
notebook...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(That expression—is it "worry"? Come to 
think of it, I detected an unnatural 
quality in her previous response as 
well...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(Which means... Master isn't enjoying this 
from the bottom of their heart? There are 
hidden emotions?)
choice_data_list: Ah... Welcome back, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master. Today, let us execute "enjoying 
ourselves from the bottom of our hearts."
choice_data_list: あ……お帰り、ブルボン！

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Commencing footbath immersion. Expected 
benefits: 'Autonomic nerve regulation,' 
'Relaxation'—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
How do you feel, Master? I infer you are 
transitioning toward a state of reduced 
tension.
choice_data_list:
Yeah! I'm starting to work up a bit of a 
sweat too.

Right! I'm starting to work up a bit of a 
sweat too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Condition: stable. Now, let us execute 
"conversation." It is reported that 
talking while in a footbath can be 
expected to increase intimacy.
choice_data_list: だな！少し汗もかいてきたかも
だね！少し汗もかいてきたかも
choice_data_list_en: Yeah! I think I'm breaking a sweat too.
Right! I think I'm breaking a sweat too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master's perspiration confirmed. Elevated 
mood confirmed. Surely your "troubles" 
have eas—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(...! Still looking troubled. It seems the 
situation hasn't improved. —Devising the 
next course of action...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock, knock, knock!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rally continuing. Master, a new high score 
has been achieved.
choice_data_list:
Incredible, no matter how I hit it, you 
return it...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me. Continuing execution— The 
exercise program is effective for mental 
recovery."
choice_data_list: すごい、どう打っても返してくれる……！
choice_data_list_en: Amazing, no matter how I hit it, she returns it...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Failure confirmed. Re-evaluating 
strategy——...Error."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, is this... fruit milk?
choice_data_list:
I thought you might be thirsty, so here 
you go!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...However, there's only one.
choice_data_list: 喉が渇いたかなと思って、どうぞ！
choice_data_list_en: I thought you might be thirsty, so here you go!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master.
choice_data_list: ブルボンに買ってきたからね
choice_data_list_en: I bought this for you, Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I want you to enjoy it as well.
choice_data_list: Bourbon...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...I sense that you have been deeply 
troubled about something with a serious 
expression for a while now."
choice_data_list: ブルボン……？

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you act cheerful in front of 
me... I want to clear your errors. Please, 
let me execute this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I was a little surprised. It seems I 
had caused Mihono Bourbon unnecessary 
worry without realizing it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, it brought a sense of 
joy. To see that she had come to reflect 
so deeply upon the matters of the 
"heart"...
choice_data_list:
You were agonizing over it because you 
wanted to enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...What does that mean?
choice_data_list: 悩んでいたのは、楽しむためだよ
choice_data_list_en: All that worrying was just so you could enjoy yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I show my notebook. In it, I had jotted 
down today's schedule and the location of 
the hot spring town.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...If only you had asked, I would have 
installed it for you.
choice_data_list: But you want to think about it, right?
But I want to think about it, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What would make this child happy? What 
would be best for her...? She pondered so 
deeply it showed on her face.
choice_data_list: でも、考えたいだろ？
でも、考えたいじゃない？
choice_data_list_en: Still, you want to think about it, don't you?
Still, don't you want to think about it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Unable to complete scan. The heart is 
exceedingly complex. I can never fully 
comprehend it, and am left perpetually 
bewildered.
choice_data_list: ブルボンが大切だからな！
ブルボンが大切だからね！
choice_data_list_en: Because you're important to me, Bourbon!
Because you're important to me, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...And yet, it was 'warm.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Logged into memory. 'Troubles' born of 
'affection'. Thank you, Master.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After enjoying the hot springs, as we 
walked along the night path... I suddenly 
noticed Mihono Bourbon staring over at 
me."
choice_data_list: Is there something on my face?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: 何か顔についている？
choice_data_list_en: Is there something on my face?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Between Master today and my father, I 
found a slight resemblance."
